content:
incident-bot: ALERT: synthetic check 'canary-auth-eu' started failing (401) for 3 consecutive runs, failure rate 18% over the last 5m. Paging oncall.
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-98231 created and paged the on-call rotation: severity=high. Link: https://pd.example/INC-98231
maria g: acked the page :ok_hand: i'm oncall for this shift, jumping in
ashwin: thanks maria. i'm seeing 401s from the eu-health endpoint too. quick check: was there any token rotation or deploy in the last hour?
samira: nope no deploys in infra but we did roll credentials for service-account-synth 35m ago via vault-rotator job.
kevin: confirmed the vault rotation job ran at 1998885600 and rotated service-account-synth keys. synthetic secret is a different store though, might not have been updated.
maria g: can someone paste the failed request logs? want to confirm error payloads
ashwin: logs (cut):
```
2026-03-14T12:14:05Z canary-eu POST /v1/health 401 {"error":"invalid_token","msg":"expired token"}
2026-03-14T12:14:12Z canary-eu POST /v1/health 401 {"error":"invalid_token","msg":"token not found"}
```
samira: that matches - vault-rotator rotated SA creds but we didn't wire the new token to the synthetic runner. probe still using old token -> 401.
maria g: impact assessment: are any customer-facing requests failing or is this strictly synthetic probes?
kevin: only synthetic probes are failing. No other 401 spikes in production metrics. Verified by quick search across proxy logs for same client id.
sre-rotation: automated pager: escalated to secondary after 5m without ack from primary (already acked by maria). Notifying infra lead.
maria g: mitigation plan:
  1) update synthetic secret with new token from vault (manual) -> quick fix
  2) pause canary-runner in eu for next 10m to stop noise
  3) add guard in vault-rotator to push updated token to synthetic-secret-store next time
ashwin: i'll update the synthetic secret and pause the runner. doing step 1 now.
kevin: to pause: `kubectl scale deployment canary-runner-eu --replicas=0 -n synth` (have perms if you need me to run)
ashwin: pushed new token into synth-secret-store and restarted runner. watch logs for next 2 runs.
samira: new runs showing 200s now :tada:
maria g: nice — can we also make the probe tolerant for short-lived auth failures and only page at >10% for 10m? current threshold is 5m/5%
kevin: agree. lowering sensitivity will reduce noise. propose: page when failure_rate > 10% over 10m OR >30% over 2m (for hard outages).
sre-rotation: note added to incident: runbook id synth-ops-4a -> update thresholds and add token-sync step to credential rotation playbook.
maria g: root cause: vault-rotator rotated service-account-synth without updating synth-secret-store. mitigation: manual secret sync and paused runner. customer impact: none (only synthetic).
ashwin: continuing to monitor. i've left a small retention log in #eng-ops for follow-ups.
samira: creating follow-up ticket: IMPACT-392: add automatic webhook from vault-rotator -> synth-secret-store + add e2e test verifying synthetic auth after rotation. assigning to infra and devex.
kevin: also recommend adding a short smoke test after vault rotations that hits /v1/health using the new token before completing rotation pipeline.
maria g: resolution summary posted to PD and will convert this thread to a short postmortem. timeline:
  - 1998885600 vault-rotator rotated creds
  - 1998887700 canary started failing
  - 1998887777 page fired
  - 1998887901 manual secret sync
  - 1998888009 runner healthy again
maria g: closing pager in PD now. thanks all for quick response :heart:
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident INC-98231 status changed to resolved by maria g. Duration: ~16m.
sre-rotation: follow-ups created: IMPACT-392, PM-98231-postmortem. tagging product & security for awareness.
maria g: postmortem link (draft): https://docs.redwood/postmortems/INC-98231-canary-401-token-rotation
kevin: noted. will add an alert test to CI pipeline.
samira: ok moving this to done in the oncall board. good catch everyone.
